def transform(grid):
    # Marked 1s define the beginning of a diagonal ray; continue it in color 2
    # at the same step length as the spacing between the given marks.
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(pts)>=2:
        pts.sort()
        dr=pts[1][0]-pts[0][0]
        dc=pts[1][1]-pts[0][1]
        r,c=pts[-1]
        while 0<=r+dr<len(out) and 0<=c+dc<len(out[0]):
            r+=dr; c+=dc
            out[r][c]=2
    return out
PY
